method: Official URLs discovered through search results and one observed primary-page link. Search listings were discovery only. Nine selected primary bodies reviewed: six publisher overview/FAQ bodies plus three help bodies.

reviews.readScope: Product page; complete substantive text lines10–318 read across overlapping views. Images, linked documentation and runtime not inspected.
reviews.publisherObservation: Events, task lists, natural-language input, calendar sets, meeting creation, widgets, travel notices and Apple-device coverage. FAQ separates importing ICS from subscribing and directs calendar sharing to providers. Automation includes Shortcuts and Mac-only MCP; AI availability is qualified by platform, hardware, language and beta restrictions.
reviews.limits: Publisher claims only. Do not transplant its tasks, AI, watch, Mac, integration, privacy or widget-count claims to Cloud. Reset/delete instructions are competitor-specific and not recommended here.

reviews.readScope: Product page; complete substantive body lines7–44; navigation/footer through144 also displayed.
reviews.publisherObservation: Multiple calendars for different groups, invitation-based participation, combined or filtered views; paid tier advertises attachments, pinned events and additional view options.
reviews.limits: Price varies by region; no comparative price conclusion. Group membership is not equivalent to every provider permission model.

reviews.readScope: Product page; complete substantive body lines22–221, including onboarding and plan summaries.
reviews.publisherObservation: Family schedule coordinates people, reminders and agenda emails alongside lists and meal planning. Publisher describes iPhone, Android and web access and a family account. Higher plans add search, change notifications and AI tools.
reviews.limits: Popularity, rating, testimonials and promotional superiority were not adopted as evidence. Do not infer bidirectional sync from generic compatibility wording.

reviews.readScope: Publisher FAQ used as selected primary body; complete substantive body lines1–11; homepage not reviewed.
reviews.publisherObservation: Explicitly says groups are planning/chat conveniences rather than separate communal calendars. Visibility is controlled through friends, close-friends and private-event settings.
reviews.limits: Do not label its group model the same as an editable shared provider calendar. No claim Cloud includes social graph or chat.

reviews.readScope: Product page; complete substantive body lines9–174 across two views.
reviews.publisherObservation: Family calendar sits alongside shared lists, household budget, meal planning, media, messaging, location/safe-zone alerts and private groups. Advertises mobile and desktop access.
reviews.limits: These household functions are not Cloud capabilities. Marketing promises such as never missing events were not adopted.

reviews.readScope: Feature page; complete substantive body lines55–223, including linked feature labels and solution examples; target bodies not implied read.
reviews.publisherObservation: Organization-oriented sub-calendars, differentiated permissions, custom fields, multiple views, feeds, event pages and website embedding; examples cover equipment, rooms and staff availability.
reviews.limits: Feature labels are publisher evidence, not runtime verification. Resource availability/booking is not established for Cloud. Browser/mobile parity must not be inferred.

reviews.readScope: Additional help body; complete substantive lines6–33.
reviews.publisherObservation: Explains visibility by calendar membership; personal home/activity views and linked external calendars are not automatically visible to other members.
reviews.limits: TimeTree-specific behavior; do not generalize to Cloud or Google.

reviews.readScope: Additional help body; complete substantive lines1–80; related link labels110–121 also read.
reviews.publisherObservation: Cozi URL import is a snapshot; continuing subscription is read-only and described as premium. Gives mobile/web import steps, preview and a free-import event limit.
reviews.limits: June2024 page; do not promote limits/pricing without fresh product confirmation. Cozi instructions are FamilyWall documentation, not a first-party Cozi workflow verification.

reviews.readScope: Additional help body; complete substantive lines2–69; reached through observed feature-page link6.
reviews.publisherObservation: Administrator chooses accessible sub-calendars and a permission for each. Separate controls cover new-calendar defaults, changing access and revocation.
reviews.limits: Do not import its permission matrix into Cloud; check actual provider/product permissions.

limits: No measured Google ranking, search volume, popularity or ChatGPT citation evidence.
No third-party ranking or review claims adopted.
Complete body means accessible textual main content, not images/video, every linked page, authenticated features or hands-on testing.
No Cloud feature verification undertaken in this batch.
